summary: Enviri Corp filed an 8-K disclosing three stockholder lawsuits and demand letters challenging disclosures in its definitive proxy statement for the proposed sale of its Clean Earth business to Veolia Environnement S.A. The suits allege omissions in the proxy statement and seek to enjoin the special meeting scheduled for May 4, 2026, or the consummation of the transactions. No deal terms (price, premium) are stated in this filing. The company has not yet stated a board recommendation or named advisors. The structural steps involve a merger and separation agreement. Watch for court rulings on injunctive relief and potential supplemental disclosures.
